description: This source file implements utility functions for self-healing in a network device, including checking LTE provisioning, interface status, route tables, and device mode, with logging and system control commands.

classes.name: xle_attributes
classes.description: Structure holding various network and device status attributes.

methods.name: check_lte_provisioned
methods.description: Checks LTE provisioning status and updates provided string buffers.

methods.name: GetInterfaceStatus
methods.description: Executes a shell command to get network interface status and copies result.

methods.name: PopulateParameters
methods.description: Initializes network parameters, checks LTE status, interface states, and route tables, and logs details.

methods.name: isWan_up
methods.description: Logs whether the LTE WAN interface is up or down based on internal state.

methods.name: Get_Device_Mode
methods.description: Retrieves device mode setting from system configuration.
